name: Agent Trust Layer (ATL)
one_line_value_proposition: Identity, capability policy, human approval and a sandboxed executor in front of AI-agent tool calls, with a tenant-scoped tamper-evident ledger.
buyer_problem: Agents that can call tools (files, databases, HTTP) need authorization, approval for risky actions and evidence of what actually ran.
solution_summary_public: Principals are issued secrets; a manifest defines tools, risk levels, parameter constraints and grants; invocations are authorized (with approver for high-risk tools), executed under a subprocess or Docker sandbox, and written to a per-tenant hash-chained ledger with evidence blobs, anchoring and erasure support.
differentiators_public: Write-ahead audit sidecar that fails closed if the intent cannot be recorded.
Abandoned-request reconciliation: a request is never re-executed; the client gets its recorded outcome or an explicit 'unknown'.
Standard-library Python; optional KMS/Vault key providers (tested against mocks only).
verified_capabilities: 21 tests collected locally (2026-10-15): 7 executed and passed, 14 skipped because they require a Docker daemon or py_ecc.
Sandboxed executor design: no network, read-only root, dropped capabilities, resource limits, digest-pinned image.
Ledger verification modes: structure-only, anchored, and keyed (strongest).
unverified_claims: Docker executor tests were skipped in this review (no Docker daemon available).
Vault and AWS KMS providers are tested against mocks only (author's own statement).
ZK identity assertion is not wired into the gateway (author's own statement).

public.headline: Put policy, approval and evidence between your AI agents and their tools.
public.subheadline: ATL authorizes each agent tool call against a capability manifest, optionally requires an approver, executes it in a sandbox and records the outcome in a hash-chained, anchorable ledger that verifies offline.
public.cost_of_inaction: Unscoped agent tool access and unverifiable action logs are a governance gap. Qualitative statement; no statistic cited.
public_limitations: SQLite single writer; single static admin token; no tool-adapter mechanism (tools hardcoded in worker.py).
Structure-only verification cannot detect a database writer who recomputes the chain; anchors or the master key are required.
Overlaps with CTAL's tenant-scoped hash-chained ledger.
architecture_public: Principal auth → capability policy → (approver) → sandboxed worker → ledger + evidence → anchor → offline verify.
Optional audit sidecar for http.client / urllib / DB-API calls.
public.risk_summary: Docker path not exercised in this review; mock-tested key providers; ledger overlap with CTAL; ownership review pending; no revenue or customers.
